home.description: Explore international study, prepare your application and plan your next step with an ISG advisor.
home.introTitle: Big ambitions. A thoughtful starting point.
home.introText: International study can feel complicated. ISG helps you make sense of the options and prepare with purpose.
services: Understand your academic profile and explore study pathways that could suit your goals.
Get practical support with documents, personal statements and application requirements.
Work with an advisor who helps you navigate decisions and understand your next steps.
home.pathTitle: Where will your ambition take you?
home.pathText: A first degree, a new specialism or an original contribution. Start with the pathway that feels like you.
home.pathNote: Funding availability and provider requirements vary. Every pathway begins with your individual circumstances.
home.processTitle: A little clarity goes a long way.
home.processText: You don't have to figure everything out at once. Here's how we move forward together.
steps: Create your account and complete the short consultation form. No documents are needed yet.
Pay TZS 50,000 once and upload a private receipt. The fee is credited toward your ISG package.
Book a confirmed meeting, then complete your full details and requested documents. Follow-ups are included.
Review the actual provider, approve each application and follow its independent updates.
home.cityText: Study abroad starts with understanding the place as well as the programme. Explore your destination, language requirements and everyday life alongside your academic options.
stories: Explore how international study can connect communities and ideas.
Learn alongside people with different experiences and perspectives.
Understand the places, languages and institutions behind your study choices.
Build knowledge you can carry into the next chapter of your life.
home.careText: Good guidance starts with honesty. Understand the support, the costs and the opportunities before deciding how to proceed.
carePoints: No applications sent without your authorization
No sensitive documents in your first assessment
home.faqTitle: A few things you might be wondering.
home.faqText: Clear answers before you take your next step.
home.ctaTitle: Your next chapter starts with a conversation.
home.ctaText: Bring your ambition. We'll help you understand the path ahead.

faqs: What does ISG help me with?
We help you understand study pathways, review your academic profile and prepare applications. The support and any fees are agreed before paid work begins.
No. Scholarship providers, universities and immigration authorities make their own decisions. An initial assessment does not guarantee funding, admission or a visa.
Do I need an account to start?
Yes. Create an account with your email and password before starting a consultation. Email confirmation is not required to register. Your progress is saved in your account.
Will I know where applications are sent?
Yes. You receive provider details, requirements, relevant costs and data-sharing information before authorizing an application.
How much does the service cost?

Consultation costs TZS 50,000 once and is credited toward a later ISG service package. Follow-up questions and further meeting requests are included, subject to scheduling. ISG package prices are separate from university, provider, visa and travel fees.
Your information is used to review your goals and contact you. Marketing consent is optional. Your profile is not published or shared with an institution without appropriate authorization.
